messages:
alex: Heads-up: we're shipping redwood-sdk v1.0 today and marking v0.9 deprecated. Full migration guide and docs refresh are published. Link in thread.

maya: ETA for EoL?

alex: Deprecation = security fixes only for 90 days. After that (roughly 2026-06-30) v0.9 goes EoL. Recommend upgrading by 2026-04-01 to avoid surprises.

sanjay: What are the user-facing breaking changes we need to highlight?

alex: Two big ones that will trip people: import paths and streaming semantics.

alex: 1) Import path change: old `from redwood import Client` -> new `from redwood.client import RedwoodClient`.

alex: 2) Streaming now returns an async generator (no callback). Example migration in the guide: 
```
# v0.9 (sync/callback style)
client = Client(api_key)
client.stream(prompt, on_chunk=handle)

# v1.0 (async generator)
from redwood.client import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key)
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt):
    handle(chunk)
```

maya: Package name unchanged (redwood-sdk) right? Any env var changes?

alex: Package name stays `redwood-sdk`. We bumped minimum Python to 3.9. Also introducing RW_API_KEY as the preferred env var; REDWOOD_API_KEY still read for compat but will warn. Docs show how to rotate env vars.

sarah: I'll put together a customer-facing release note and an email template with the migration checklist.

sanjay: I'll prepare support KB entries: import errors, asyncio transition issues, and common traceback examples. Also will add a quick triage flow for support engineers.

devrel-bot: release: redwood-sdk 1.0.0 released on PyPI — https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/1.0.0 :tada:

docs-bot: docs site updated under /sdk/; migration guide deployed. CDN cache purge scheduled at 10:45 UTC.

maya: Can we add a one-page "upgrade checklist" (3-5 bullets) for customers who need to move fast?

alex: Done in the PR: short checklist, code samples, and an "if you can't upgrade yet" section with pinning/routing examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

sarah: We'll also host a 30-min migration webinar next Wed. I'll coordinate with comms.

alex: Action items: @sarah draft customer email & release notes; @sanjay publish KB + canned replies; @maya pin the checklist in community; docs team to monitor analytics for migration-related search terms. Thank you! :rocket:
